messages.author: 6d3f7222550fe21b
messages.subject: decouple 2 legends; fill/color
parts:
Alternate subject: Eliminate meaningless plot character from legend

In the example below, I want two legends which clearly give information about 2 different factors. One legend should be for the "fill" and the other for the "color".

One solution, as I show, is to explicitly use layer().

But I think Hadley wrote that he might eventually deprecate the layer() function. (Also, explicit use of layer() is not well documented.) Is there another way to achieve the same result?

stuff<-data.frame(eks=1:10)
stuff$Why<-stuff$eks
stuff$GRUEP<-factor(with(stuff, ifelse(eks<5, "lo", "HI")))
stuff$EVENNESS<- factor( ifelse(((stuff$eks) %% 2)<1, "even", "odd"))
print(summary(stuff))
print(stuff)
library(ggplot2)

# Bad: Meaningless plot character in the "GRUEP" legend and meaningless black in the "EVENNESS" legend:

print(
ggplot(data=stuff, mapping=aes(x=eks, y=Why, fill=GRUEP, color=EVENNESS)) + geom_tile() + geom_point(shape=16, size=5)
+ scale_fill_manual(
values=c(
"lo"="yellow"
,
"HI"="pink"
)
)
+ scale_color_manual(
values=c(
"even"="green"
,
"odd"="red"
)
)
)

# Solution using layer():

layerGRUEP<-layer(
data=stuff
, mapping=aes(x=eks, y=Why, fill=GRUEP)
, geom="tile"
)
layerEVENNESS<-layer(
data=stuff
, mapping=aes(x=eks, y=Why, color=EVENNESS)
, geom="point"
)
print(
ggplot()
+ layerGRUEP
+ layerEVENNESS
+ scale_fill_manual(
values=c(
"lo"="yellow"
, "HI"="pink"
)
)
+ scale_color_manual(
values=c(
"odd"="green"
,"even"="red"
)
)
)

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: decouple 2 legends; fill/color
parts:
Is this what you were after?

ggplot(data=stuff, mapping=aes(x=eks, y=Why)) +
geom_tile(mapping = aes(fill = GRUEP)) +
geom_point(mapping = aes(color = EVENNESS), shape=16, size=5) +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("pink", "yellow")) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("green", "red"))

If so, notice where the fill and color aesthetics were assigned. In
your plot code. You had color and fill mapped to *all* subsequent
layers - i.e., color and fill were implicitly mapped to both
geom_tile() and geom_point(). The above code assigns fill to
geom_tile() and color to geom_point().

Dennis
